column1: # Folketingsvalgene den 20. Maj 1910 (Statistiske Meddelelser, 4. Række, 35. Bind, 2. Hæfte); constituency tables pages 20-46, by-elections page 47
# "Ugyldige og blankt afgivne Stemmesedler" is a single bracketed figure printed for both lines; a ditto mark (") in a ballot line is written 0
# two polling places printed: Kallundborg Købst. for the mainland parishes, Onsbjerg for Samsø
# misprint: 27 Præstø Amt 4 candidates 2395 + blank 11 = 2406 (2410 with the 4 unreturned) against 2409 voted; the book's footnote refers to Note 2 on page 16 on discrepant reported figures
# misprint: 42 Skanderborg Amt 5 candidates 3155 + invalid 3 + blank 6 = 3164, one more than the 3163 voted; the book's footnote refers to Note 2 on page 16 on discrepant reported figures
# misprint: 44 Ringkøbing Amt 1 candidates 1710 + invalid 12 + blank 12 = 1734, two more than the 1732 voted; the book's footnote refers to Note 2 on page 16 on discrepant reported figures
# the Faroe Islands (printed "Færø Amts Valgkreds") voted on 4 June 1910 (footnote on page 46)
